title: Contempt
grade_or_penalty: 4th degree; DV restraining order violations: 4th degree if the conduct is also a crime or offense, otherwise disorderly persons
key_points: Purposely or knowingly disobeying a judicial order or protective order, or hindering or obstructing the execution of an order.
elements: A court order (such as a restraining order) existed
The suspect knew of the order (served, or had actual notice)
The suspect purposely or knowingly disobeyed it
For DV orders: note whether the violating conduct was itself a crime or offense (sets the grade)

subsections.label: a
subsections.text: Contempt: purposely or knowingly disobeys a judicial order or protective order, or hinders its execution

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: Violating a DV restraining order (or DV conditions of release)
subsections.grade: 4th degree if the conduct is also a crime or offense; DP otherwise
